findings.claim: The public export getScalarValue now takes a string instead of a ParserState, and CHANGELOG.md doesn't record this breaking API change.
findings.evidence: src/index.ts:97 still has `export { getScalarValue } from './parser/parser_scalar.ts'` (index.ts is not in the diff), so the function is part of the package API. The diff changes `function getScalarValue (state: ParserState, ...)` to `function getScalarValue (input: string, ...)` and removes `const { input } = state`. If a caller passes a state object now, `input.slice` / getPlainValue(input, ...) run against an object instead of a string. All callers inside the repo were updated (from_events.ts:105, constructor.ts:152), and the locked test/spec/spec.test.mjs:166 already calls `getScalarValue(input, event)` with a string, so the new signature is what the test expects. But CHANGELOG.md has no Unreleased or Changed entry that records the breaking API change.
